channel.title: BuildFlow for Mac
channel.description: Updates to BuildFlow for Mac, newest first.

item.title: Version 0.2.0
item.description:
**BuildFlow's look, in your notch.**
- **The dropdown is a BuildFlow window now**: the same cards, tabs, colours and type (Inter and Inter Tight) as the website. - **Light and Dark.** Choose Light, Dark or Match macOS from the gear in the dropdown, or from the menu-bar icon. - **A greeting each time you open it.** Press Control + Option (left side) and it says good morning, good afternoon or good evening before showing your day. - **Alerts have Open and Later buttons.**

item.title: Version 0.1.0
item.description:
**The first BuildFlow for Mac.** Your MacBook's notch becomes a small BuildFlow window.
- **A greeting** when you open the lid or unlock: "Good morning", with one line about your day. - **Your inbox**: notifications, upcoming jobs, meetings, and what's waiting on you. Press Control + Option (left side) to open BuildFlow in the notch, or hover it. - **Voice**: hold Control + Option to talk, and ask about your schedule. Nothing changes until you press Accept. - **Updates** arrive on their own from now on. You can also choose Check for Updates… in the menu bar.
